description: Pure library module to validate that enrichment modules read multiple metadata fields. Expose validate_enrichment(module_path: str) -> dict with keys: {field_count: int, fields_used: list, distinct_metadata_keys: set, coverage_score: float}. A coverage_score >= 0.7 requires reading >= 3 distinct metadata fields. This prevents weak single-field enrichments that produce poor discrimination. Will be run against all *_enrichment.py files. No DB, no network.
